articles.summary: We are excited to announce that we will be attending the Consensus 2023 conference in Austin, Texas, from April 26 to 28. The conference is one of the largest events in the blockchain and cryptocurrency industry, bringing together thought leaders, entrepreneurs, and developers to discuss the latest trends and innovations in the space. As part of the conference, our COO, Nicolas Roussy Newton, will be a guest speaker on the "Problem Solvers: CoinDesk Projects to Watch" panel on Friday, April 28
articles.title: BTQ Participating in "Problem Solvers: CoinDesk Projects to Watch" Panel at Consensus 2023
